audit_md:
# Website Health Check: Hometech Remodeling LLC

## What we saw on 13 November 2026

- **hometechremodeling.com has no website.** It loads a blank page that forwards to a GoDaddy "for sale" listing, which answered "Access Denied" at desktop and at 390px phone width (screenshots saved).
- Registration record: created 21 Aug 2023, expires 21 Aug 2027, registrar Dynadot, DNS at Afternic's for-sale nameservers.
- Wayback Machine captures from 2004, 2016, 2021, 2024 and 2025 are all parking or placeholder pages; no archived Hometech Remodeling site exists.
- **No Google Business Profile:** Maps searches for the name with 757 Ridgewood Ave, and for (732) 967-7777, returned only other firms.
- **The business is in good standing:** NJ contractor registration 13VH09579000 is Active; BBB accredited with an A+ rating since 2019.

## What it means for customers

Someone who adds ".com" to the company name reaches an error page, and someone who searches the name on Maps finds other companies. There is no page of their own showing services, photos or a way to request a quote.

## How to fix it

1. Confirm who holds the registrar account and whether the business ever owned the domain (owner, 0.5–1 h).
2. If not, register a clean alternative with auto-renew rather than paying a resale price (owner/web person, 0.5–1 h).
3. Launch a small site: galleries, service area, click-to-call and a quote form (web person 8–16 h; owner 2–3 h for photos and copy).
4. Create and verify a Google Business Profile (owner, 1–2 h plus verification).
5. Point BBB and BuildZoom at the new site, claim BuildZoom, and add domain, certificate and uptime alerts (1–2 h).

## After the fix

Collect reviews: BuildZoom records none and there is no Google profile to collect them on, so a texted review link after each finished project would give the A+ accreditation visible proof to sit beside.

---

Prepared from publicly available information on 13 November 2026. We did not log in to or change anything.
